groups.message:
fix: atomic write-then-rename for progress files

write_progress() used Path.write_text() which truncates before writing.
Process crash between truncation and write loses all prior progress.
Now writes to .tmp then os.replace() — atomic on POSIX.

Refs #271

feat: work-end orchestrator — Python-driven close sequence

Stateless re-entrant orchestrator that owns the work-end close sequence.
Yields ACTION= lines for judgment steps, runs mechanical steps silently.
Atomic progress tracking via close_progress.py with stale detection.
131 tests across orchestrator, close_progress, close_report, and
existing work-end test files.

Refs #271

feat: rewrite work-end for orchestrator dispatch

Replace 662-line LLM-orchestrated skill with 425-line dispatch model.
Pre-close context resolution, ~20-line dispatch loop calling
work_end_orchestrator.py, action handlers with per-action judgment
constraints. close_report step names updated to match orchestrator
sequence. Blog, design spec, and decisions promoted from workspace.
